IBBA Team

Source: R/ibba.R
ibba_team.Rd

One team-season: standings line and club profile (colours, sponsors, social links, arena id).

Endpoint: GET https://basket.co.il/ws/ws.asmx/TeamById

Usage

ibba_team(team_id, team_uid, season)

Arguments

team_id

(integer required): Team-season id (new every season; Maccabi = 1109 in 2025-26): team_id in ibba_teams, ibba_games home_team_id / away_team_id or ibba_box_score.

team_uid

(integer required): IBBA club id, stable across seasons (Maccabi Tel Aviv = 10; team_uid in ibba_teams). Use 0 for all clubs only where the route says so.

season

(integer required): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26); sent to the host as cYear unchanged.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
team_uidintegerIBBA CLUB id, stable across seasons (Maccabi Tel Aviv = 10): the team_uid parameter of the roster routes. Not the per-season team_id.
team_idintegerTeam-season id (key space: IBBA team registrations; a NEW id every season for the same club, e.g. Maccabi Tel Aviv = 1109 in 2025-26 and 2111 in 2026-27). Joins ibba_teams, ibba_players, ibba_coaches, ibba_box_score and the games' home / away ids.
seasonintegerSeason END year as an integer (2026 = 2025-26): the host's own cYear, no mapping.
team_name_hecharacterTeam name in Hebrew, HTML-unescaped.
team_short_name_hecharacterShort team name in Hebrew, HTML-unescaped.
team_namecharacterTeam name in English as registered for the season.
team_short_namecharacterShort team name in English.
winsintegerGames won in the season so far (standings line).
lossesintegerGames lost in the season so far (standings line).
points_forintegerPoints scored over the games played.
points_againstintegerPoints conceded over the games played.
table_pointsintegerStandings points (2 per win, 1 per loss in the league table).
placeintegerRank in the standings of the board (1 = first).
website_urlcharacterClub website URL.
photo_pathcharacterSite-relative path of the photo (team or player picture); prefix with https://www.basket.co.il.
icon_pathcharacterSite-relative path of the small team icon.
logo_urlcharacterAbsolute URL of the team logo.
icon3_pathcharacterSite-relative path of the third team icon variant.
arena_idintegerHome arena id in the IBBA site's own arena table (no arena route is modelled).
address_hecharacterClub address in Hebrew, HTML-unescaped.
addresscharacterClub address in English, HTML-unescaped.
colors_hecharacterTeam colours in Hebrew.
colorscharacterTeam colours in English.
sponsors_hecharacterClub sponsors in Hebrew, comma-separated.
sponsorscharacterClub sponsors in English, comma-separated.
about_hecharacterClub profile in Hebrew as HTML markup (honours, history); not stripped.
aboutcharacterClub profile in English as HTML markup; null when the club has none.
facebook_urlcharacterClub Facebook page URL; null when none.
twitter_urlcharacterClub Twitter / X profile URL; null when none.
instagram_urlcharacterClub Instagram profile URL; null when none.
youtube_urlcharacterClub YouTube channel URL; null when none.
subscribe_urlcharacterSeason-ticket subscription URL; null when none.
diary_urlcharacterCalendar-subscription (add-to-diary) URL of the club's fixtures.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in ibba_configuration().

 ibba_team(season = 2026, team_id = 1109, team_uid = 10)
